title: The Inspired Word of God
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Bring a Bible with a contents page for every pair. Sing a books-of-the-Bible song the church uses locally (teacher to choose).

skills.key_step: The child sorts well-known books into the Old Testament (Genesis, Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah) and the New Testament (Matthew, Luke, John, Acts), knows Genesis opens the Bible and Matthew the New Testament, and finds a book from the contents page.
representations: two shelves drawn on the board: Old Testament, New Testament
steps: Find where the New Testament starts (Matthew).
Sort the cards onto two shelves.

board.do: Draw two shelves: Old Testament and New Testament.

board.say: Which shelf does Psalms go on?

board.do: Wait for the child to place it.
Show the contents page to check.

misconceptions.ask: Which book is in the Old Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the Bible in two halves and sort book names on cards.

misconceptions.ask: Which book is in the New Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Sort the cards again and say which half each belongs to.

misconceptions.ask: Which is the first book of the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Open a Bible together at the first page.

misconceptions.ask: How many books are in the Old Testament in the Protestant Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Remember: the Old Testament is the older, longer part: 39. The New Testament: 27. Check on the contents page.

checks.question: Is Acts in the Old or the New Testament?
Which is the first book of the Bible?
